note: The High venv cache path into the release was judged overstated: its writers are pull_request runs (merge-ref scope) and pushes to the protected main, approved code, so no untrusted run writes it, Low. Corrected after reading the workflows: the push-to-main `worker/ci` job runs `abatilo/actions-poetry@v2`, an unauthorized mutable action, so a compromised version of it writes the default-branch venv cache the release restores ("approved code on main" does not cover a dependency that changes under its tag); the cache path holds at that writer's High ceiling. No job here declares cache-mode, so GitHub keeps the cache of every low-trust run read-only and grants no job cache write: ISSUE-705 is silent and no cache path exists, so the cache ceiling admits none.
